**`DB` (i.e. `postgres.DB`) — `store/db/postgres/postgres.go`**

It's declared at line 16 and satisfies the `store.Driver` interface:

```16:19:store/db/postgres/postgres.go
type DB struct {
	db      *sql.DB
	profile *profile.Profile
}
```

`NewDB` in the same file opens a `postgres` connection using the profile DSN and returns `&DB{...}` typed as `store.Driver` (the interface is defined in `store/driver.go`). The rest of the interface methods are spread across sibling files in that package — `memo.go`, `user.go`, `attachment.go`, and so on — all with `*DB` receivers. The equivalent structs for the other dialects are also named `DB`, in `store/db/sqlite/sqlite.go` and `store/db/mysql/mysql.go`, so qualify by package when disambiguating.
